status: Continuous face succeeded; eye reflections regressed

history.title: First portrait: anatomy and silhouette review
history.notes: Recognizable original bust, but eyes protrude and show too much white; lower face is too long; hair reads as shiny ribbons; collar and sleeves need softer construction.
history.review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.

history.title: Improved eyes, proportions and cloth; scalp needs refinement
history.notes: Eye placement, iris clipping, lower-face proportions and shoulder joins improved. Remaining problems: hard eyelid transitions, exposed smooth scalp, ribbon-like hair, low collar, and stylized likeness. Browser screenshot timed out during continuous 3D rendering.
history.review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.

history.title: Scalp coverage and hair drape improved; facial seams remain
history.notes: Leading-edge fibers cover the bare scalp; hair ends retain gravity-led drape and the collar sits higher. Remaining: visible eyelid seams, overly simplified nose and lips, rigid collar leaves, and stylized rather than reference-level likeness.
history.review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.

history.title: Continuous face succeeded; eye reflections regressed
history.notes: The eye holes and lips share continuous topology, but the new eye curvature washed out the iris reflections. Profile review exposed a receding chin and pointed nose; rear hair has repetitive ridges. This pass is not accepted as an improvement.
history.review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.
